title: Reason Code 34: the account is disabled
plain_english: NPS found the account and it is disabled in Active Directory. The credentials may well be correct; the account state blocks the logon before the password is even checked. If the User Name starts with 'host/', the disabled object is a computer account, not a person.

any: specified in the RADIUS Access-Request message is disabled

causes.cause: A user account was disabled (offboarding, HR sync, lockout policy) but a device still has the network profile and keeps trying.
causes.next_check: Confirm with Get-ADUser <name> -Properties Enabled; then use the event's Calling Station Identifier to find the device that keeps trying and remove the profile.

causes.cause: Machine authentication with a disabled computer account (identity 'host/NAME').
causes.next_check: Look at the User Name in the event: if it starts with host/, check the computer object in Active Directory Users and Computers and re-enable or rejoin the machine.
